verdict.rationale: The evidence pack only describes Godot's generic asset-import pipeline (auto-import to res://.godot/imported/, bulk import parameter changes) but never mentions glTF, FBX, or USD specifically, nor any hands-on report of clean or problematic imports for these formats — missing for 10: explicit glTF/FBX/USD import documentation, fidelity/compatibility notes, and any community corroboration of import quality for technical artists.
